items.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free at a Lexus dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Check engine light from a stuck fuel flow control valve
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump / flow control valve
items.note: Ask a dealer whether any coverage applies.

items.t: Hard starting or check engine light from low fuel pressure
items.job: Diagnose and replace in-tank fuel pump if not under recall
items.note: Free if a fuel pump recall applies to your VIN.

items.t: Check engine light for turbo overboost
items.job: Diagnose boost control; reprogram or repair per bulletin

items.t: Water pump coolant leak
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: RepairPal lists about $734-$825 total for this job.

items.t: Rear brakes squeak after sitting overnight
